answers.core: This behavior is already implemented for the enter signals, and should behave similarly for the exit signals too.
answers.workaround:
The workarounds I currently use to get an accurate array back from get_overlapping_areas/bodies() are:

- Yielding for a few frames until it is updated (simple, but not ideal)
- Extending the Area class to maintain its own array of overlapping bodies that I can control (more verbose, but accurate).

title: Update get_overlapping_bodies/areas() before on area/body_exited signal is called on Area3D Node
